prompts.title: Price by size and condition
prompts.summary: Package prices for sedans, SUVs and trucks, with condition upcharges.
prompts.prompt: Build detailing prices. Target per hour [$]. Hours for interior, exterior and full detail on a sedan [ ], add [%] for SUVs and [%] for trucks or vans. Condition upcharges: pet hair, heavy stains, sand [ ]. Add-ons: [ ]. Give a price menu and the line I use when someone asks why a dirty car costs more.
prompts.use: Ask for two photos before you quote.

prompts.title: Before-and-after reel
prompts.summary: A 15-second reel brief built around the reveal.
prompts.prompt: Write a 15-second before-and-after reel brief for a [vehicle] at [business]. Plan the first second (the worst spot), three working shots, the reveal with the sound moment, on-screen words (six at most) and the caption with the package and price.
prompts.use: Film every job's worst spot first, before you touch it.

prompts.prompt: Write a monthly maintenance plan for [business]: what's included each visit and the price [ ]. Then a short text to send the day after a full detail offering it.
prompts.use: Offer it to every full detail.
